purpose: Readiness inventory, not an executable queue or device authorization. Object order is not scheduling order; docs/ROADMAP.md alone owns priority. Exact inputs, budgets and chronology stay in linked experiments.
selection_note: Corrected disconnect monitor and kernel-thread scan validated on Buildbox. The failed predecessor remains recorded; a fresh attended boot-specific admission is required.

a53-authenticated-baseline.owner: A53 baseline and queued device tests
a53-authenticated-baseline.readiness_note: Baseline observation, authentication, readable console and complete log preservation passed. Supplemental recovery review verifies changed-ID Gemian return while preserving the original inconclusive native-request witness and incomplete aggregate. All session budgets consumed; dependent preparation may proceed, execution is not admitted. See baseline/RECOVERY_WITNESS_REVIEW.md.

keyboard-coverage.owner: A53 baseline and queued device tests

dependencies.required_result: Exact frozen baseline first boot passes authenticated USB and console serviceability; input interface is identified. Ten completed cold boots are not required.

keyboard-coverage.readiness_note: Candidate R's exact proof admission was published and executed once. The first no-PTY connection received the harmless fixture marker with complete stdin and killed the client at 0 ms; the sole export connection then exited 1 in 0.439 s with empty stdout/stderr. The end-to-end proof is inconclusive: lifecycle and reader release are unproven, all connection budgets are consumed, no retry is permitted, and no keyboard capture or hardware claim exists. Changed-boot Gemian was authenticated on 2026-09-08; see experiments/2026-09-07-keyboard-boot2-session/results/gemian-resume-20260908.json. Former session is no longer live; no recovery mechanism or remote-partial preservation is claimed.

emmc-readonly.owner: A53 baseline and queued device tests

dependencies.required_result: Exact frozen baseline passes serviceability with reviewed recovery and the read-only protocol has exact device identity and finite budgets. Keyboard coverage is independent.

emmc-readonly.readiness_note: Single read and log budgets consumed. Independent changed-ID Gemian confirmation passed; native request transport remains inconclusive and the aggregate remains incomplete. Exact results and pause closure are in the readiness record. No retry or dependent test selected.

wifi-parent-attribution.readiness_note: Completed Gemian metadata observations; budgets consumed and custody released. No new boot2 candidate. Corrected helpers are not admitted for another attempt.

wifi-live-nvram-identity.readiness_note: Offline packet passed independent review. Its first one-SSH invocation refused before the admission barrier, so no selected data was read and the observation budget remains unconsumed. Do not retry automatically; re-establish live OS/transport and review a fresh admission if boot identity changed. No boot2 candidate or partition write.

dependencies.required_result: Reuse the authenticated USB serviceability and changed-ID Gemian recovery foundation; the prior TOPRGU restart action is not repeated.

mt6797-consys-passive-boot.readiness_note: The exact passive candidate passed verified installation, one owner boot2 selection and one authenticated collection. Changed boot identity, exact release, healthy logger and BOUND generation 1 passed with all seven effect counters zero. A second changed boot identity confirmed known-good Gemian recovery. Both budgets are consumed, custody is released and the candidate must not be retried. No usable-Wi-Fi claim.

dependencies.required_result: Authenticated USB serviceability, complete log preservation and changed-ID Gemian recovery are accepted preparation inputs.

mt6797-toprgu-minimal-restart.readiness_note: The candidate was selected once. Authenticated serviceability and logging passed, but live ramoops reported zero address and size, so no restart request was issued and the attempt is inconclusive. The owner physically recovered the device; one bounded authenticated check confirmed changed-ID Gemian 3.18.41+ on AArch64. The artifact is consumed and must not be retried; diagnose its DT/ramoops composition offline.

keyboard-console-ownership.readiness_note: One authenticated baseline, three null PID-1 descriptors, owner-readable console, authentication and complete log preservation passed. Changed-ID Gemian return confirmed; native request transport remains inconclusive with no retry. Original aggregate remains incomplete; existing supplemental verifier accepts the recovery evidence. All observation budgets consumed.

dependencies.required_result: Passing exact-candidate console observation and authenticated baseline/archive, with log preservation and reviewed supplemental changed-ID Gemian recovery; original incomplete SSH witness retained.

keyboard-console-disconnect.readiness_note: Quiet-client-loss regression reproduced and fixed; explicit kernel-thread scan classification added. ARM64/QEMU monitor tests and exact BusyBox disconnect tests pass, new package validated. Existing boot2 candidate unchanged. Fresh guarded handoff and actual boot-specific binding required; execution remains disabled.
